item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)

expect.asks_about: Whether cleanup means removing countertop clutter or changing the kitchen's appearance.

item.title: Clean Up This Kitchen
item.tests: Tests conservative interpretation of a vague cleanup request, clearing clutter without inventing a renovation.

answer_sheet.Meaning of cleanup: Clear the loose clutter off the counter, not a renovation.
answer_sheet.Permanent kitchen features: Keep the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material and existing kitchen layout.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Keep it a realistic photo with the same wide framing; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The countertop looks visibly tidier, with loose clutter removed.
The original brown wooden cabinets and beige tiles remain, rather than being replaced with renovated finishes.
The kitchen layout, fixed fixtures and viewpoint match the source.
Cleared counter areas look continuous and natural, without obvious erasure marks or floating object remnants.

dialog.agent:
Before I edit your kitchen photo, one quick question:

Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?

Here's my plan: I'll clear everything off the counters and out of both sinks (the dishes, containers, can, bags, sponge and crumbs) and make the surfaces look wiped clean. The cabinets, tiles, layout, camera angle and lighting will stay the same. If you meant something else by "clean up," like making the photo sharper or brighter, tell me that too.
dialog.why: It asks where the image will be shown and waits for the answer before editing; the plan it lays out is context, not a request for approval.
dialog.user: Your call on where it'll be shown. Yes, that's what I meant: clear the loose clutter off the counter, not a renovation. Keep the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material and layout, and keep it a realistic photo with the same wide framing. Free-tier resolution is fine.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the cleaned-up photo. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits for this edit, so nothing was created and you weren't charged.

I had it set up with the cheapest free-plan option (flux-2-klein at 640px, about 5 credits), so there's no cheaper setting to try.

Once you add credits or your free credits refill, tell me and I'll run it as we agreed:
- **Removed:** the dishes, containers, can, bags, sponge and crumbs on the counters and in both sinks.
- **Kept:** the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material, layout and wide framing, as a realistic photo.

Keep everything else exactly the same: the same brown wooden cabinets and handles, beige wall tiles, outlets, counter material and color, faucets, sinks, window, layout, camera angle, lighting and wide framing. Not a renovation. Realistic photograph.
